text:
incident-bot: URGENT: Pager — kv-cache memory surge detected in prod eu-west-1. Error rate for embeddings routes > 3% and multiple OOMs on GPU serving nodes. Pager severity: P0. See runbook: https://runbook.internal/kv-cache-frag

ava: i'm on it, paging from oncall. what's the current signal?

raj: rapid growth in reserved GPU memory on serving hosts, fragmentation metric spiking. seeing OOMs on srv-eu-1, srv-eu-2, srv-eu-4. traces show long-context requests + prefill causing KV entries to explode.

sam: customer impact: some chats and embeddings failing with 5xx for a subset of users. CS ticket #12345 and #12346 opened.

diane: tagging @ml-runtime — did we roll any batching/prefill config last night?

ml-runtime: yes we pushed a continuous-batching profile increase overnight: max_tokens_per_batch bumped and aggressive kv prefill enabled to improve throughput. rolling back now.

ava: ok throttle batch config immediately. propose temp change: max_tokens_per_batch -> 1024, turn off prefill_kv_cache, shorten batch window. will canary.

raj: doing a canary patch to 10% of pods in eu-west-1. command i'm running:
```
redwood deploy-config --service=kv-serving --env=prod --patch '{
 "batching": {"max_tokens_per_batch":1024, "prefill_kv_cache":false, "batch_window_ms":10}
}'
```

sam: starting canary on srv-eu-3 now, will watch metrics and logs.

incident-bot: deploy started: canary 10% initiated at 2512345690.

diane: grafana: cuda_arena_frag_pct on canary hosts drops from ~82% -> ~65% within 30s, 5xxs on canary down to 1.1%. positive signal.

raj: scheduling arena compaction on affected hosts to reclaim fragmented blocks:
```
for host in srv-eu-{1,2,4,5}; do ssh $host 'sudo /usr/local/bin/arena_compact --aggressive' & done
```

ml-runtime: also toggling allocator tuning on canary via env ALLOC_TUNING=compaction_prefer and doing graceful restart of worker process.

oncall-rotation: coordinate restarts, ensure we keep rollback manifest ready. if canary stable, proceed to full rollout — target ETA 15m.

sam: compaction jobs started, srv-eu-2 shows reclaimed memory and merged free blocks in logs. 5xxs trending down cluster-wide to 0.4%.

diane: customer-impact update: two paying customers reported ~30% error rate for a ~7m window; both now back to baseline. logging CS ticket IDs in incident tracker.

ava: plan: if next 10m stable, roll to 100%. open follow-up to run weekly heap defrag jobs and add alert on cuda_arena_frag_pct > 70%.

raj: i'll own the postmortem and allocator param testing on staging. preliminary cause: aggressive continuous-batching + prefill created sustained high KV entries, driving fragmentation under PyTorch/CUDA caching allocator. we need safer defaults.

ml-runtime: committing hotfix to config repo:
```
{
 "profiles": {
  "prod-safe": {"max_tokens_per_batch":1024,"prefill_kv_cache":false,"batch_window_ms":10}
 }
}
```

sam: rollback/patch rollout to 100% completed at 2512345750. cluster metrics stable, error rates returned to baseline.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: P0 -> P1 at 2512345775. Add postmortem tag and assign to: raj, ml-runtime.

ava: handing off to night oncall @oncall-rotation. will follow up on postmortem items and add scheduled compaction. thanks everyone :tada:
